answer_1.quote: This paper aims to develop a structure-aware LLM that excels in various KGC tasks by effectively integrating structural information.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses for triple classification (True/False) and link prediction (target entity).

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we evaluate triple classification using four standard metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and assess link prediction with two metrics: Hits@1 and MRR.
